---
title: "Historical specifications and delivery records"
---

These pages preserve the reasoning and delivery history behind RiX. They can
include proposed syntax, superseded APIs, old implementation gaps, or completed
checklists. They are excluded from the site's search index in both documentation
build modes so a search for today's API leads to current guides. Existing URLs
remain available for citations and links.

For supported behavior, start with [implementation status](status.qmd), the
[language reference](eval/syntax-guide.md), the [plugin catalog](plugin-catalog.md),
or the [generated runtime catalog](reference/system-reference.md).

| Historical material | Current starting point |
|---|---|
| [Early language specification](design/parser/spec.md) and [open design questions](design/parser/questions.md) | [Language reference](eval/syntax-guide.md) |
| [April 2026 review](report-2026-04-02.md) | [Implementation status](status.qmd) |
| [Handwritten IR snapshot](design/eval/ir-format.md) | [Generated IR registry](reference/system-reference.md#internal-ir-registry) |
| [Document roadmap and notation proposals](design/eval/document-output-todo.md) | [Document persistence](eval/document-persistence.md), [publication layout](eval/publication-plan.md), and [assets](eval/output-assets.md) |
| [Reactive control delivery plan](design/eval/control-panel-todo.md) | [Reactive controls](eval/controls-guide.md) |
| [RiXCel delivery checklist](design/eval/rixcel-todo.md) | [Workbooks](eval/workbooks.md), [tensor editing](eval/rixcel-tensors.md), and [regional output](eval/rixcel-regions.md) |
| [Structural arithmetic completion record](design/eval/structural-arithmetic-todo.md) | [Structural values](eval/objects/structural-values.md) |
| [Plugin roadmap and rendering proposals](design/plugins.md) | [Plugin catalog](plugin-catalog.md) and [renderer guide](eval/renderer-guide.md) |

Current implementation contracts remain searchable even when their source lives
under `design/`. In particular, concurrency semantics, runtime performance
measurements, output contracts, and the RiXCel format are useful current
references. File location alone does not determine whether a page is historical.

Unpublished scratch notes, old generated parser HTML, and reports outside the
explicit site render list remain repository history; they are not documentation
search results.
